note: Johnson County AR publishes no countywide GIS or zoning layer, and Arkansas counties generally do not zone. The only Clarksville AR zoning ArcGIS service found (maps.townofclarksville.com Planning/ClarksvilleZoning) is actually Clarksville, Indiana (extent in IN), so it is not usable. Town of Clarksville AR zoning appears only as PDF ordinance and map; no queryable zoning service found for Johnson, Coal Hill, Hartman, Knoxville or Lamar.
